name: Workforce Capacity Planner
summary: Calculates available hours, workload, utilisation and the staff needed from team size, working time and task volumes.
description: Calculates the productive hours your team has in a period (after absence and non-productive time), the hours your task volumes require, utilisation, the gap against a target utilisation, and the FTE and headcount needed. Each task's share of the workload is shown, so you can see what drives demand. Who it's for: operations, support and service managers planning staffing for a period. Limitations: assumes work spreads evenly across people and the period (no peaks, shifts or skill constraints) and that minutes per task include all handling time.
problems: How many people do we need to handle this workload
Is the support team over capacity
Calculate staffing needs from task volumes and handling time

inputs.label: Weeks in the period
inputs.description: Length of the planning period in weeks.

inputs.label: Productive time %
inputs.description: Share of working time spent on these tasks (after meetings, training...).

inputs.label: Absence %
inputs.description: Holidays and sickness as a share of time.

inputs.label: Target utilisation %
inputs.description: How full you want the team to be (default 85).

inputs.label: Tasks and volumes
inputs.description: Each task with its volume in the period and minutes per task.
inputs.example:
Tickets: 2000 at 6 minutes each
Calls: 300 at 20 minutes each

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation
outputs.description: What the results mean, with numbers taken only from the calculation.

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Read your data
steps.responsibility: Copy your figures into the calculation's input exactly as written.
steps.prompt: Read each task with its volume for the period and the minutes each one takes. Copy numbers exactly.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered workforce_capacity@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Explain whether the team has enough capacity, how utilisation compares with the target, which tasks drive the workload, and what staffing change follows. Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.

criteria.description: Every number in the summary comes from the calculation or your inputs.
Every number in the key points comes from the calculation or your inputs.
The summary is 90 words or fewer.
